abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 429 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 415 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 499 | 800 |
